lines.japanese:
一瞬とも、永遠ともつかない刻。
　２人はお互いのぬくもりを確かめ合い、
そしてまた離れた。
lines.english: A span that might have been an instant, or an eternity. They felt each other’s warmth, then drew apart once more.

lines.japanese:
忍は名残惜しそうに、沙也加は振り払うように。
　ただその後ろ髪が、風になびいて忍の手をくすぐる。
lines.english: Shinobu drew away reluctantly; Sayaka pulled back as though shaking him off. Only her trailing hair, streaming in the wind, tickled his hand.

lines.japanese: 「歩きましょう」
lines.english: “Let’s walk.”

lines.japanese:
離れていく沙也加。
　忍は細い糸に引かれるように、不自然な歩みで
寄り添った。
lines.english: Sayaka moved away. As if drawn by a slender thread, Shinobu followed in awkward steps until he came alongside her.

lines.japanese:
誰もいない校庭をゆっくりと歩く。
　グラウンドの中央へは向かわず、敷地沿いに。
lines.english: They walked slowly through the empty schoolyard, skirting the grounds rather than heading toward the center.

lines.japanese:
半分地面に埋まった車のタイヤが、いくつか並
んでいた。
lines.english: Several car tires stood in a row, half buried in the earth.

lines.japanese:
等間隔に並ぶそれに乗って遊ぶのだろう。
　今乗ったら重みで倒れてしまいそうな不安に駆
られる。
lines.english: The evenly spaced tires were probably there for children to play on. Shinobu could not shake the fear that one would topple beneath his weight if he tried it now.

lines.japanese:
沙也加は興味がないようで、一瞥することも
なく歩を進めていた。
lines.english: Sayaka appeared uninterested and walked on without so much as a glance.

lines.japanese:
鉄棒。
　錆びて埃の被っている鉄の棒。
lines.english: A horizontal bar. An iron bar, rusty and coated in dust.

lines.japanese:
興味があるのか、目を向ける。
　手を伸ばして、バーに触れた。
lines.english: Something about it caught her eye. She reached out and touched the bar.

lines.japanese: 「……懐かしい？」
lines.english: “…Does it bring back memories?”

lines.japanese: 「いいえ」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: 「え、そう？」
lines.english: “Oh. Really?”

lines.japanese: 「懐かしむための記憶を持っていないもの」
lines.english: “I have no memories to feel nostalgic for.”
“Ah…”

lines.japanese:
そういえば、鉄棒で遊ぶ沙也加、
という記憶はない。
lines.english: Come to think of it, he couldn’t remember ever seeing Sayaka play on a horizontal bar.

lines.japanese:
もちろんタイヤも、ジャングルジムも、雲梯も、
ブランコだって。
lines.english: Not on the tires, the jungle gym, the monkey bars, or even the swings.

lines.japanese:
バーに触れた指先を見ると、赤茶けた錆が付着
していた。
lines.english: He looked at Sayaka’s fingertips where they had touched the bar. They were stained reddish brown with rust.

lines.japanese: 忍は慌ててハンカチを取り出し、沙也加に差し出す。
lines.english: Shinobu hurriedly pulled out his handkerchief and offered it to Sayaka.

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう」
lines.english: “Thank you.”

lines.japanese: 「いえいえ、どういたしまして」
lines.english: “No, no. You’re very welcome.”

lines.japanese: 得意満面。
lines.english: He beamed with pride.

lines.japanese:
「しわくちゃでなければ、
　もう少し高得点だったわね」
lines.english: “It would have earned a higher score if it weren’t so wrinkled.”

lines.japanese: 意気消沈。
lines.english: His spirits plummeted.

lines.japanese:
（次からはハンカチを２枚用意しておかないと
　いけないようだよ）
lines.english: (I suppose I’ll have to start carrying two handkerchiefs.)

lines.japanese: フェミニストを気取るには用意が足りていなかった。
lines.english: He had come ill prepared to play the gentleman.

lines.japanese: 「忍は？　懐かしい？」
lines.english: “What about you, Shinobu? Does it bring back memories?”

lines.japanese:
「そうだね、少しは……けど、僕もこうした遊具で
　遊んだ記憶はあんまりないから」
lines.english: “A little, I suppose… But I don’t have many memories of playing on playground equipment like this either.”

lines.japanese:
「そう？　あずさや章二と遊びまくっていたような
　気がするのだけれど」
lines.english: “Really? I seem to remember you playing on it all the time with Azusa and Shouji.”

lines.japanese: 「そうかな」
lines.english: “Did I?”

lines.japanese:
「あずさが、手に大きなマメを作った
　こともあったわね」
lines.english: “There was the time Azusa got an enormous blister on her hand.”

lines.japanese:
「うーん、あったかも……
　鉄棒じゃなくて、雲梯だった気がするけど」
lines.english: “Maybe… Though I think it was the monkey bars, not the horizontal bar.”

lines.japanese:
「手のひらいっぱいにできたマメよ。
　なんだか怖かったわ」
lines.english: “A blister covered almost her entire palm. It was rather frightening.”

lines.japanese:
「あぁ、思い出した思い出した。
　そんなこともあったね」
lines.english: “Right, right—I remember now. That did happen, didn’t it?”

lines.japanese:
「あれを見て、私は絶対に鉄棒なんて
　しないと思ったものよ」
lines.english: “Seeing that made me swear I would never touch a horizontal bar.”

lines.japanese: 「……雲梯だろうと、なんだろうと」
lines.english: “…Or monkey bars, or anything of the kind.”

lines.japanese:
「確かに、沙也が鉄棒してるところなんて
　想像できないね」
lines.english: “I really can’t picture you on a horizontal bar, Saya.”

lines.japanese: 「……やってみる？」
lines.english: “…Want to try?”

lines.japanese: 「やらないわ」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: 「そっか」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese:
少し触れただけで赤錆のつく鉄棒に触れるのは、
忍にも若干の抵抗があった。
lines.english: Shinobu himself was none too eager to touch a bar that left red rust on his skin at the slightest touch.

lines.japanese:
汚れることそのものではなく、汚れたことで
沙也加に触れられなくなることを恐れたためだ。
lines.english: It was not the dirt itself he feared. He feared that once his hands were dirty, he would no longer be able to touch Sayaka.

lines.japanese: 「なに？　……ブランコ？」
lines.english: “What is it? …The swings?”

lines.japanese: 沙也加の視線が、ブランコをとらえていた。
lines.english: Sayaka’s gaze had settled on the swings.

lines.japanese: 歩み寄り、鎖に触れる。
lines.english: She walked over and touched one of the chains.

lines.japanese:
同じように赤錆の浮いた鎖だ。
　指にもつくだろうに。
lines.english: The chain was similarly speckled with red rust. It would stain her fingers too.

lines.japanese: 「……懐かしがってるみたいだね」
lines.english: “…You do look nostalgic now.”

lines.japanese:
「そういうわけではないわ……
　けれど、あの子の笑顔は思い出すわね」
lines.english: “That isn’t quite it… But I do remember that girl’s smile.”

lines.japanese: あずさのことだろう。
lines.english: She probably meant Azusa.

lines.japanese:
「懐かしいな。
　ブランコに乗るのなんて、何年ぶりだろう」
lines.english: “This does take me back. How many years has it been since I went on a swing?”

lines.japanese:
となりのブランコに座る。
　鎖に触れるとやはり錆が付着したけれど、
気にしないことにした。
lines.english: He sat down on the swing beside her. The chain left rust on his hand, just as expected, but he decided not to let it bother him.

lines.japanese: 沙也加も、しっかりと鎖を握っていたから。
lines.english: Sayaka, after all, had taken a firm hold of her own chains.

lines.japanese: 「ブランコならマメもできないよ」
lines.english: “A swing won’t give you blisters.”

lines.japanese: 「そうでしょうね」
lines.english: “I expect not.”

lines.japanese:
「えーっと……もしかして、
　ブランコにも乗ったことなかったっけ？」
lines.english: “Um… Don’t tell me you’ve never been on a swing either?”

lines.japanese: 「ないわ」
lines.english: “I haven’t.”

lines.japanese: 「さすがは生粋のお嬢様でいらっしゃいますね」
lines.english: “A true young lady through and through, I see.”

lines.japanese: 「嫌味」
lines.english: “Sarcasm.”

lines.japanese: 「滅相もない」
lines.english: “I wouldn’t dream of it.”

lines.japanese:
言いながら、ブランコをこぎ始める忍。
　スムーズに加速していく様を見て、沙也加は不愉快
そうに睨み付けた。
lines.english: As he spoke, Shinobu began to pump his swing. Watching him gather speed with ease, Sayaka fixed him with an irritated glare.

lines.japanese: 「睨んでないで乗ってみたら？」
lines.english: “Instead of glaring, why not try it?”

lines.japanese: 「結構気持ちいいよ……あ、足だけ気をつけて」
lines.english: “It feels pretty good… Just watch your feet.”

lines.japanese:
今の忍たちには、踏み台の位置が低すぎる。
　足の位置に注意しなければ、地面に激突して
しまいかねない。
lines.english: The swing seats hung far too low for them now. Unless they watched where they put their feet, they might slam them straight into the ground.

lines.japanese: 「気をつけると言ってもね……」
lines.english: “How exactly am I supposed to do that…?”

lines.japanese: 「まずはゆっくりとさ……ほら、こうして」
lines.english: “Start slowly… Here, like this.”

lines.japanese:
一旦停まって、沙也加と同じポーズ。
　地面を蹴って足を伸ばし、漕ぐように足を揺らし
て勢いをつける。
lines.english: He stopped and took up the same posture as Sayaka. Kicking off the ground, he stretched out his legs, then swung them back and forth to build momentum.

lines.japanese:
「あぁ、なるほど……
　地面に足がぶつかりかねないのね」
lines.english: “Ah, I see… Your feet could easily hit the ground.”

lines.japanese:
「立ち乗りしてもいいけど、初心者には
　座り乗りの方が安心だから」
lines.english: “You can stand if you want, but for a beginner, sitting is safer.”

lines.japanese:
初心者扱いが気に入らないようだが、なにも言い
返せない沙也加だった。
lines.english: She plainly disliked being treated as a beginner, but could think of no reply.

lines.japanese: 「見てても乗れないよ？」
lines.english: “You won’t learn by watching.”

lines.japanese:
「……フン。
　誰も乗るだなんて言っていないじゃない」
lines.english: “…Hmph. I never said I intended to ride it.”

lines.japanese:
「子供のようにブランコに乗って
　はしゃぐだなんて……」
lines.english: “Riding a swing like a child and getting all excited…”

lines.japanese: 「いいから、乗ってみなってば」
lines.english: “Come on. Just try it.”

lines.japanese:
観念したのか、ブランコを睨み付ける沙也加。
　忍は漕ぐ勢いを弱め、そっと見守る。
lines.english: Apparently resigned, Sayaka glared at the swing. Shinobu let his own momentum ebb and watched her quietly.
“Ah.”

lines.japanese: 「んっ……んっ……んっ」
lines.english: “Nn… nn… nn.”

lines.japanese: 「乗れた乗れた……あ。足気をつけて」
lines.english: “You’re doing it, you’re doing it… Ah. Watch your feet.”

lines.japanese:
「一度にあれもこれも……
　ひゃっ……危ないわねこれっ」
lines.english: “You want me to do all that at once…? Ah! This thing is dangerous.”

lines.japanese:
地面を蹴るジャリッとした音に肝を冷やす。
　しかし沙也加はとまることなく、忍を真似て足を
揺らした。
lines.english: The scrape of her shoes against the ground made his blood run cold. But Sayaka did not stop. She copied Shinobu and began to swing her legs.

lines.japanese: 「んっ……んんっ……んっ」
lines.english: “Nn… nnn… nn.”

lines.japanese: 「その調子、その調子」
lines.english: “That’s it. Just like that.”

lines.japanese: 「ふん……ふん……ふんっ」
lines.english: “Hmph… hmph… hmph.”

lines.japanese:
「気合いだけ入れてもしょうがないよ？
　もっとこうタイミング良く」
lines.english: “All that determination won’t get you anywhere, you know. You need to get the timing right.”

lines.japanese: 「タイミング？」
lines.english: “The timing?”

lines.japanese:
「そうそう。上と下で足を振るタイミングを
　間違えなければ……」
lines.english: “Right. Just time the movement of your legs with each rise and fall…”

lines.japanese:
「っと！　だからって、あんまり振り過ぎると
　危ないって！」
lines.english: “Whoa! That doesn’t mean you should swing them that far! That’s dangerous!”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そうね……これくらい、かしら？」
lines.english: “Y-yes… Is this about right?”

lines.japanese: 「いいね、スムーズに動けてると思うよ」
lines.english: “Good. You’re moving smoothly now.”

lines.japanese: 「そう……んっ……んっ！」
lines.english: “I see… Nn… nn!”

lines.japanese: 「わ、わ、わ」
lines.english: “Whoa, whoa, whoa!”

lines.japanese:
すぐに足を着く沙也加に、忍はホッと胸を撫で
下ろした。
lines.english: Sayaka put her feet down at once, and Shinobu breathed a sigh of relief.

lines.japanese: 「ふぅ」
lines.english: “Whew.”

lines.japanese: 「ふ～……ハラハラしたよ」
lines.english: “Whew… That had me on edge.”

lines.japanese: 「沙也？」
lines.english: “Saya?”

lines.japanese: 「ふぅん、そういうこと……わかったわ」
lines.english: “Oh. I see how it works now.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「それ！」
lines.english: “There!”
“Ah.”

lines.japanese:
勢い良くブランコを漕ぎ出す沙也加。
　止める間もなく、あっという間に大きな振りに
なっていく。
lines.english: Sayaka sent the swing surging forward. Before he could stop her, it was sweeping through a broad arc within moments.

lines.japanese: 「沙也加？」
lines.english: “Sayaka?”

lines.japanese: 「気持ちいいわね」
lines.english: “This feels wonderful.”

lines.japanese: 「……そうだね」
lines.english: “…It does.”

lines.japanese:
どうやら、もう安心して良さそうだ。
　忍も自分のブランコを揺らし始める。
lines.english: It seemed he could stop worrying now. Shinobu began to pump his own swing again.

lines.japanese: 夕暮れの校庭に、鎖のきしむ鈍い音が響き渡った。
lines.english: The dull groan of the chains rang across the schoolyard at dusk.

lines.japanese: 「……ずいぶん楽しんだみたいだね」
lines.english: “…Looks like you enjoyed yourself.”

lines.japanese:
「なかなか気持ち良かったわ。
　これなら、前からやっておけば良かったわね」
lines.english: “That was rather pleasant. I wish I’d tried it before.”

lines.japanese:
そうすれば、懐かしむこともできたかもしれ
ないから。
lines.english: Then perhaps she would have had something to remember fondly.

lines.japanese: 「今日のことを、後で懐かしく思う日が来るさ」
lines.english: “One day, you’ll remember today fondly.”

lines.japanese: 「そうね」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese:
そう思いたい。
　思うだけならば、誰の迷惑にもならない。
　―――はずだ。
lines.english: He wanted to believe that. There couldn’t be any harm in believing it. —Surely.

lines.japanese: 「……手、汚れてない？」
lines.english: “…Are your hands dirty?”

lines.japanese: 「ハンカチを貸してくれる？」
lines.english: “May I borrow your handkerchief?”

lines.japanese: 「しわくちゃの物で良ければ」
lines.english: “If you don’t mind the wrinkled one.”

lines.japanese: 「構わないわ」
lines.english: “I don’t.”

lines.japanese: 「……どうせ、拭い取れはしないけれど」
lines.english: “…Though it can’t be wiped away anyway.”

lines.japanese:
石けんで手を洗わなければ、擦りついた赤錆は
落ちないだろう。
　色は落ちても、匂いは残るだろう。
lines.english: Without soap and water, the red rust smeared over their hands would not come off. Even if the color faded, the smell would remain.

lines.japanese: それはまるで――のように。
lines.english: It was just like—
